# CalcDigi

> Free online calculation tools, interactive visual graphs, and smart calculators across Finance, Health, Math, Science, Internet, Geography, Transportation, and more.

## Formulas & Methodology
- Mortgage Payment: M = P [ i(1 + i)^n ] / [ (1 + i)^n – 1]
- BMI Formula: weight (kg) / [height (m)]^2
- Break Even (units): Fixed Costs / (Price - Variable Cost per Unit)
- All calculations run 100% client-side in-browser with zero telemetry.

## Core Calculators & Tools

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/finance/mortgage-calculator): Calculate monthly mortgage payments, amortization schedule, taxes, insurance, PMI, and extra payments.
- [BMI Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/health/bmi-calculator): Compute Body Mass Index, healthy weight range, and category breakdowns.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/finance/compound-interest-calculator): Calculate investment growth with compound interest and regular contributions.
- [Loan Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/finance/loan-calculator): Estimate personal or auto loan repayments and interest costs.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/health/calorie-calculator): Calculate daily caloric requirements based on BMR, age, and activity level.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/math/percentage-calculator): Compute percentages, percent changes, and fraction conversions.
- [Age Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/datetime/age-calculator): Exact age calculation in years, months, days, hours, and minutes.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/calculators/finance/auto-loan-calculator): Car financing, monthly payments, trade-in value, and taxes.

## Categories

- [Finance](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/pages/finance): Mortgage, loan, investment, interest, tax, and budget calculators.
- [Health](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/pages/health): BMI, calorie, body fat, macro, and fitness calculators.
- [Math](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/pages/math): Algebra, geometry, percentage, fraction, and scientific calculations.
- [Science](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/pages/science): Physics, chemistry, molarity, density, and half-life calculators.
- [Internet](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/pages/internet): Bandwidth, data transfer, download speed, and IP subnet calculators.
- [Transportation](https://calc-digi.vercel.app/pages/transportation): Fuel cost, mileage, commute, EV savings, and travel calculators.
